findings.resolution: Production service now returns a bounded EVIDENCE root and exposes subject-, scope-, source-, group-, and chain-bound group/page traversal over the content-addressed block DAG. Cursor tamper, wrong authority, stale source, group-integrity failure, cold restart, oversized Unicode, and complete 100000-event traversal are covered.

v43 adds an immutable per-work-item recovery ledger, durable drain proof, exact parking identity, lease owner/generation revocation, worker parked recognition, and full re-scan/recalculation before quiescence. Forged summaries, omissions, stale generations, unknown gaps, races, faults, and restart fail closed without deleting raw rows.

findings.summary: The frozen S4 plan requires a queued primary turn to actually start one Runtime 0.7 root Run, while also excluding the S5-owned context, provider, tool, and execution-authority composition required to construct that start safely. Existing production code has a durable FIFO reducer but no valid scheduler execution seam; fixture ports cannot close this requirement.

note: The two independent code defects are closed on one clean integrated Host commit. Phase 3 cannot be declared complete and Phase 4 cannot start until the S4/S5 scope contradiction is explicitly resolved and the plan is rewound through challenge and acceptance review.
